coherenceChange.required: two successfully captured valid linked regular-file snapshots; exact owning PID/start-time/role still matches; metadata identities match; both paths classifiable under existing ownership/dependency rules; no observed deleted or zero-link target; no runtime-proof bypass
coherenceChange.contextErrorSlot: validated change mask, not native errno or managed HResult; sampled schema only

admission.rationale: No census or unknown-byte upper bound is claimed. A post-observation quality threshold would not establish either. Every enumerated candidate and every classified loss is reported, including unknown bytes and types.

unchanged.allOtherInheritedRequirements: unchanged: workload/order/providers/durations/offered populations/95-percent floor/requests/RSS/decision rule/drain/publication/reopen/exact package and retained-root inventories/cleanup

storageClaim: non-atomic observed sampled maxima only; unknown lost bytes/types; no descriptor census and no instantaneous aggregate storage guarantee
finalChecks: quiescent complete root inventory and exact package/history/suite limits remain mandatory; boundary descriptor samples may lose known candidates but root enumeration, ownership and cleanup never receive a loss exemption
readiness: new policy-bound manifest, source and binary inventory, host, runtime environment, compact context map, sealed all-eight raw coverage and independent review bound to the exact prospective campaign; no feasibility boolean substitution
legacy: strict default and frozen documents unchanged; old artifacts inspection-only and never upgraded
